summary: Defined AgentOS ecosystem channel policy across core, verified, organization, community and local-dev trust tiers.
acceptance_evidence: Core on stable is enabled by default for Production Distro release images.
Verified requires signed publisher, signed registry snapshot, lockfile, replay evidence and revocation metadata.
Community is discoverable and stageable only after schema and digest verification, and is sandbox-only by default.
Local-dev is developer-mode only and not production-promotable by default.
Offline pinned snapshots preserve availability but do not upgrade trust.

commands.summary: Channel policy names all required trust tiers and channels.

blocked_shortcuts: Local path placement does not upgrade trust.
Community and local-dev cannot become production-promotable by default.
Channels do not grant runtime activation authority.
promotion_impact: Freezes channel defaults before verified publisher, organization overlay and remote registry work.
